value.answer: It depends on the mortgage. If you're insured (down payment under 20%), the lowest I found is 4.34%, at Ratehub and Wowa. Uninsured rates are higher, and the sources I found don't agree on the lowest one, so I can't give you that figure. At the big banks, Ratehub has one at 4.54% and Scotiabank at 4.74%. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September.
